newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish tractor maker Uzel to float shares.
newsitem.headline: Turkish tractor maker Uzel to float shares.

text.p: Turkish tractor producer Company Uzel Makina Sanayi A.S. will float shares representing 15 percent of its capital in a two day offer beginning on July, 30-31, the company said.
According to a company announcement the fixed price will be 19,500 lira per 1,000 lira nominal valued share in the offer.
The public offer will be lead-managed by Yatirim Finansman in Turkey and Morgan Stanley abroad, the company said.

Of the 345 million shares to be floated, 293 million of them will be sold abroad, 15.5 million will be sold to company wholesale distributors and workers, 5.1 million to domestic institutional investors and 31 million to individual investors.

The company, which produces Massey-Ferguson tractors and Perkins engines as well as rims and springs for the automotive industry, reached $300 million in total sales and $80 million of gross profit in 1996.
According to the company, Uzel is listed among the largest 10 tractor producers in the world making 25,000 tractors and has 45 percent share of Turkey's domestic tractor market.
